asa_marshman: Nobody saw Henrik "Saint" Marshman arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in T-F18, and a quiet signaller under it.
Henrik "Saint" Marshman and Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.
byzantineempireirl: Walter Byzantineemp walked into S-S9 on Day 5 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

Walter Byzantineemp borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Walter Byzantineemp stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
The parcel for Walter Byzantineemp contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
The telephone went dead during the shelling. Walter Byzantineemp watched the runner leave with the written orders, then listened for the phone to ring again.
Walter Byzantineemp has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Walter Byzantineemp was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Walter Byzantineemp helped stack spare sandbags at S-S9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
The dugout has begun inventing endings to Walter Byzantineemp's story. The cook's version involves an inheritance; the corporal's involves a disciplinary hearing.
el_juanito67h: Dorian "Ash" Juanito came up the line with a book with the last pages torn out and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

A bullet went through Dorian "Ash" Juanito's sleeve at S-R5 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Zeno Emperornoble of the Hegemony (@emperornoblez). Blackwater Canal is lost. Dorian "Ash" Juanito heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Dorian "Ash" Juanito rejoined the squad at S-R5. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
falloutcat123: Leopold Falloutcat, a brewer from Brennmoor, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in S-R2. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Leopold Falloutcat wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
The whole squad at S-R2 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Leopold Falloutcat's bullet that found Konrad "Owl" Kino, grazed.
gardinerryker: Casimir "Button" Gardinerryke told the sergeant he was a printer's apprentice. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
good_ol_rags: Leopold Rags arrived with the Day 10 draft, carrying a pocket Bible with a hole in it and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Leopold Rags fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at Q-F7. Before dawn Ulrich Dutch walked into it, grazed. A letter from home found Leopold Rags before the night shift. Leopold Rags folded it small and kept it close.
jasmandeep_singh999: Felix "Tin" Singh signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-F5 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F5 and grazed Felix "Tin" Singh's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Felix Szymanski of the Hegemony (@franek.szymanski.376).
Felix "Tin" Singh no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet clipped Felix "Tin" Singh's helmet at S-F5 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. A letter from home reached Felix "Tin" Singh before dusk. Felix "Tin" Singh read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Felix "Tin" Singh kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Felix "Tin" Singh is whole again, or near enough for the line. A letter from home reached Felix "Tin" Singh before dusk. Felix "Tin" Singh read it twice and slept a little easier.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Felix "Tin" Singh received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. A letter from home reached Felix "Tin" Singh before dusk. Felix "Tin" Singh read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix "Tin" Singh fired once through the steel loophole at S-F5 and closed the shutter before the echo came back. Dietrich "Button" Slade was badly wounded. A letter from home reached Felix "Tin" Singh before dusk. Felix "Tin" Singh read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix "Tin" Singh had Karel Mccauley of the Hegemony in the sights at Verdel Ridge for a long second. Karel Mccauley was lighting a pipe. Felix "Tin" Singh let the match burn all the way down. A letter from home reached Felix "Tin" Singh before dusk. Felix "Tin" Singh read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix "Tin" Singh made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Felix "Tin" Singh crawled the last yards. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Felix "Tin" Singh read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

No bed for Felix "Tin" Singh yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up. A letter from home reached Felix "Tin" Singh before dusk. Felix "Tin" Singh read it twice and slept a little easier.
k_a_r_l____: Hugo Karl arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a child's drawing of a horse and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.
Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder of the Concord and Hugo Karl of the Hegemony share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at Hill 304 now wait for it before they sleep.
kamdensipple: Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple walked into S-F6 on Day 3 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could. Orders came through: Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a rosary of rough beads.
A clear shot from S-F6. Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple grazed Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob and slid back down below the parapet.
Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.

Dawn watch. Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Bram "Crow" Mitaylor, badly wounded. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into S-F6. Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple has learned to walk bent double.
Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
Silas Zdsh (Hegemony) and Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple (Concord) ended up in the same shell hole at the Drowned Farm. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.

Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F6. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Casimir Schradog of the Hegemony (@schradog2). Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Ulrich Pgallo was grazed.
Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple walked back up the communication trench to S-F6, slower than before, but on his own feet.

Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Albin Mouthfullofr, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Face blackened with soot, Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn was grazed.
kolonics.akos.jozsef: After 6 days of war, R-S12 had a place for everything. On Day 6, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Clement "Saint" Jozsef.
Clement "Saint" Jozsef dreamt he was back in Lindenbruck, working as a coal miner. He woke up and said nothing all morning.
Clement "Saint" Jozsef passed ration containers down a chain of hands. By the time supper reached the front, every man smelled of it.
During a lull at Calvary Farm, Isidor Glc called across from the Concord line. Clement "Saint" Jozsef answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-S12 changed before the cheering ended. Clement "Saint" Jozsef shouldered another load.

Clement "Saint" Jozsef was found at the bottom of the trench at R-S12, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Teodor "Spark" Levitobambit of the Concord (@levitobambito). Clement "Saint" Jozsef reached the hospital dugout after a long wait. The surgeon took one look at the wound and went to wash up. Clement "Saint" Jozsef opened his eyes today and asked for water. At R-S12 they cheered when the news came up the line.
leopoldda1nonly: Severin Nonly stepped off the supply cart at R-C7 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

Severin Nonly fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Severin Nonly watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Severin Nonly spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.
manningwam: Day 7: Benedikt Manningwam reached S-S5 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Benedikt Manningwam moved his hide three times today. Snipers who stay in one place do not stay anywhere for long.
Benedikt Manningwam drew a map of Norbert Bwk's hometown from Norbert's stories. Norbert says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere.

The raid hit the Hegemony line at the darkest hour. Benedikt Manningwam fought Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski in a trench no wider than a door. Benedikt Manningwam came home with Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski's cap badge. (@franek.szymanski.376) After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Benedikt Manningwam helped stack spare sandbags at S-S5. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A bullet hit Benedikt Manningwam in the neck at S-S5. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Silas Karli of the Hegemony (@hunt_karli). Benedikt Manningwam stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-S5. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Silas Karli of the Hegemony (@hunt_karli).
The papers connected Matthias Manningwam to Benedikt Manningwam. The men took longer to learn Matthias Manningwam's own habits, but they made the effort.
nza_amin: Isidor Amin told the sergeant he was a tailor. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Isidor Amin watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Isidor Amin passed ration containers down a chain of hands. By the time supper reached the front, every man smelled of it.
ofieczkaares: Silas Ofieczkaares walked into R-C15 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Silas Ofieczkaares stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Silas Ofieczkaares could not stop listening to it.
salty__trout: Lucien Trout came up the line with a lock of hair in a matchbox and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Lucien Trout was carrying water up to R-R12 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Lucien Trout did not. Shot by Ulrich "Parson" Monster of the Concord (@krotral222monster). Lucien Trout was killed on watch at R-R12. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Ulrich "Parson" Monster of the Concord (@krotral222monster).
Arno "Hollow" Trout joined R-R12 under the shadow of Lucien Trout's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Arno "Hollow" Trout thought about a grandmother who prays for both armies on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.
seamus_bj: The new sniper gave his name as Norbert Seamus. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
A bullet went through Norbert Seamus's sleeve at S-F19 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Emil Ghostbebrii of the Hegemony (@ghostbebrii).

Norbert Seamus no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A letter from home reached Norbert Seamus before dusk. Norbert Seamus read it twice and slept a little easier.

A newspaper reached Norbert Seamus with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well. A letter from home reached Norbert Seamus before dusk. Norbert Seamus read it twice and slept a little easier. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Norbert Seamus looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Norbert Seamus fished it out by feel and then had to wash again. A letter from home reached Norbert Seamus before dusk. Norbert Seamus read it twice and slept a little easier.

Norbert Seamus fired at a movement across the wire at S-F19. The man went down: Albin Donaldgregor, grazed. A letter from home reached Norbert Seamus before dusk. Norbert Seamus read it twice and slept a little easier.
Norbert Seamus took the shot at four hundred yards. The spotter whispered the result: Dietrich Thky, badly wounded.

Norbert Seamus watched the enemy lines change the guard at S-F19 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Emil Ghostbebrii was grazed. A letter from home reached Norbert Seamus before dusk. Norbert Seamus read it twice and slept a little easier.

From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Norbert Seamus wrote to an old father who runs the family shop alone that night and said only: 'We will take it back.' A letter from home reached Norbert Seamus before dusk. Norbert Seamus read it twice and slept a little easier.

Norbert Seamus lost a boot in the trench. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word. A letter from home reached Norbert Seamus before dusk. Norbert Seamus read it twice and slept a little easier.
uselesmagikarp: The draft reached T-F17 on Day 10. Bram Uselesmagika was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
Bram Uselesmagika reached up to fix a sandbag at T-F17 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Henrik "Owl" Juggernaut of the Concord (@juggernaut_dd).
vis.acquillae: Edmund Acquillae left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Halden and came up the line with a stub of a pencil. The men noticed at once that he polishes his buttons every evening.
Volunteer number 34. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Edmund Acquillae's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
Edmund Acquillae asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a signaller. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.
Edmund Acquillae was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.

Edmund Acquillae taught Silas Zdsh to play the harmonica. The bay has asked them both, formally, to stop. Day 3: Verdel Ridge was lost. Edmund Acquillae wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Edmund Acquillae dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.

A direct hit on the trench at S-F10. Edmund Acquillae was the only one they could still help, and only just. Edmund Acquillae was killed outright by a direct hit at S-F10. The men dug for an hour and found only his identity disc.

Isidor Acquillae joined S-F10 under the shadow of Edmund Acquillae's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. Isidor Acquillae received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on. Now serving as a signaller, Isidor Acquillae discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

Isidor Acquillae spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at S-F10 is closed now. Isidor Acquillae raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F10. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Wendel "Mole" Day of the Concord (@selfie_and_mugs_every_day2.0). Mail came up the line with a letter for Isidor Acquillae. Isidor Acquillae read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Isidor Acquillae helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Machine-gun fire swept S-F10. Isidor Acquillae took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Oskar Pearson of the Concord (@_william.pearson_). Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Isidor Acquillae died waiting. The men at S-F10 have not stopped talking about it.

The papers connected Roland Acquillae to Isidor Acquillae. The men took longer to learn Roland Acquillae's own habits, but they made the effort. Roland Acquillae was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns. Roland Acquillae's transfer to the role of stretcher bearer was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else. Roland Acquillae bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.'

Roland Acquillae made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Acquillae. Roland Acquillae read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Roland Acquillae began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Acquillae. Roland Acquillae read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A round went through Roland Acquillae's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich of the Concord (@coreyjmcmichael). Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Acquillae. Roland Acquillae read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The medic cut the last bandage off Roland Acquillae's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-F10 the same hour. Victory at Blackwater Canal. Roland Acquillae let himself talk about leave for the first time in days. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Acquillae. Roland Acquillae read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Roland Acquillae was made Lance Corporal. He celebrated by sleeping four hours in a row. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Acquillae. Roland Acquillae read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
